scenarios.name: safe-change
scenarios.change: Adds an optional confirmationMessage response field.
scenarios.setup: From a clean checkout, run git apply fixtures/scenarios/safe-change/change.patch.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Existing unit and API tests continue to pass; the additive response change is compatible.
expected_evidence: The existing required response fields remain present
The new field is optional for consumers

scenarios.name: performance-regression
scenarios.change: Replaces indexed findById lookup with a full orders scan and in-memory filter.
scenarios.setup: From a clean checkout, run git apply fixtures/scenarios/performance-regression/change.patch.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Functional tests still pass, but GET order lookups perform a full database read and should worsen under a populated workload.
expected_evidence: The candidate diff replaces findById with findAll
Baseline and candidate p95/p99 latency can be compared
Database query behavior is visible in the changed repository call

scenarios.name: api-compatibility-regression
scenarios.change: Removes the required status field from the order response DTO.
scenarios.setup: From a clean checkout, run git apply fixtures/scenarios/api-compatibility-regression/change.patch.
scenarios.expected_outcome: The API contract check fails because the required status response field is missing.
expected_evidence: The candidate diff removes status from OrderDtos.Response
tests/check_openapi_contract.py exits nonzero against the candidate

scenarios.name: reliability-regression
scenarios.change: Removes the Inventory client's exception handling so downstream failures escape as server errors.
scenarios.setup: From a clean checkout, run git apply fixtures/scenarios/reliability-regression/change.patch, rebuild the Order API, and start Compose.
scenarios.expected_outcome: When Inventory is unavailable, the baseline returns a persisted RESERVATION_FAILED response while the candidate returns an HTTP 5xx error.
expected_evidence: The candidate diff removes that catch path
A reserve request with inventory-mock stopped shows the behavior difference
scenarios.validation_command: docker compose stop inventory-mock && curl -i -X POST http://localhost:8080/orders/ORDER_ID/reserve

scenarios.name: infrastructure-security-regression
scenarios.change: Adds unsafe Kubernetes settings: host networking, privileged execution, and root user execution.
scenarios.setup: No application change is needed; validate the fixture from a clean checkout.
scenarios.expected_outcome: The deterministic security validator reports each unsafe setting and exits nonzero.
